messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "do not stop treatment on your own"
set: ["do not stop treatment on your own", "do not stop on your own if pregnant", "do not stop taking on your own without speaking to doctor first", "do not stop taking on your own even if you feel fine", "do not stop abruptly", "do not stop without speaking to your doctor", "do not stop taking suddenly", "do not stop using suddenly", "do not breastfeed during treatment", "do not stop taking without talking to your doctor", "do not stop using without first asking your doctor", "do not stop using venlafaxine suddenly", "do not stop using escitalopram suddenly", "do not stop using without first talking to your doctor", "do not drink alcohol during treatment", "do not change your dose"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
JSON:

completion:
{
  "duplicates": [
    "do not stop on your own if pregnant",
    "do not stop taking on your own without speaking to doctor first",
    "do not stop taking on your own even if you feel fine",
    "do not stop abruptly",
    "do not stop without speaking to your doctor",
    "do not stop taking suddenly",
    "do not stop using suddenly",
    "do not stop taking without talking to your doctor",
    "do not stop using without first asking your doctor",
    "do not stop using without first talking to your doctor"
  ],
  "alias": "do not stop treatment on your own"
}
